args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of the actions taken:

1. **Diagnosis**: checked service status and release history — checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18.
2. **Rollback**: rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that had been healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.2.9-healthy versions were older, v2.3.0 was the latest healthy one). Rollback status confirmed as rolled out.
3. **Incident**: opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the health check failures and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommend investigating the root cause of v2.3.1's failure before any future re-deployment attempt.
